responsibility: Declares the default-include-path data model and exported configuration constants that describe GCC’s built-in header search roots. It defines struct default_include, publishes the cpp_include_defaults table and configure-time prefix variables, and exposes cpp_relocated so include-path construction code can interpret which directories are C++-only, sysrooted, multilib-sensitive, or subject to relocation-aware rewriting.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration header for the cppdefault pair: it defines struct default_include and declares the built-in include-path tables, prefix constants, and cpp_relocated interface. Unlike gcc/cppdefault.cc, it does not provide the configured directory table or relocation implementation; it describes and exposes them.
